characteristics: FILLED circular rose medallion replacing the O
OUTLINED circular rose medallion with line-art rose

finding: Concept #97 does NOT depict the approved BBROSE brand asset. The two marks differ in typeface class, letterspacing, medallion treatment and registered-mark presence. This is a SOURCE-AUTHORITY conflict, not a missing-vector problem: §2 names both the concept and the approved brand assets as authority, and they disagree.
why_not_resolved_here: §9 forbids redesigning the BBROSE logo, so no third mark may be synthesized. No authoritative VECTOR logo exists, and Image Trace is prohibited.
what_was_done: The five letterforms visible in the reference are set as outlined vectors at the measured positions. The rose medallion is NOT invented: its measured bounds are parked as a non-printing guide in layer 09 and the glyph slot is left empty while still consuming its advance, so the rest of the line keeps its measured position.
owner_decision_required: A: reconstruct what concept #97 shows (letterspaced sans mark)
B: reconstruct the approved mark and accept deviation from #97
C: supply an authoritative vector logo
